title: Complete transcripts: read uses the backend conversation
notes: read takes the full transcript from the chat's backend conversation instead of the virtualized page, so long chats are no longer cut to their tail.
Deep research reports and generated files come from the conversation data and appear at their position in the chat.
read is much faster on chats with many files or images: Files-panel entries that are already known are skipped.
ask follows ChatGPT's redesigned send, stop and reply markup.
setup verifies the Browser Bridge connection and no longer reports false failures in the compiled exe.
